name: SoftIcon Related Posts
author: Faruk

sections.description:
By dynamically displaying related posts below the main content, the RelatedPosts plugin improves user engagement and navigation on your WordPress website. This plugin provides users with relevant content by intelligently identifying and displaying posts from the same category as the current post.

Feedback

This plugin is actively being developed & improved. We’re far from done and are adding new features, functionality, and fixes daily. If there’s a feature you want but we don’t have yet, please let us know.

Developer Notes
sections.installation:
Uploading in WordPress Dashboard

  • Download softicon-related-posts.zip
  • Navigate to the ‘Add New’ in the plugins dashboard
  • Navigate to the ‘Upload’ area
  • Select softicon-related-posts.zip from your computer
  • Click ‘Install Now’
  • Activate the plugin in the Plugin dashboard

short_description: Displays related posts below content based on categories to enhance engagement and navigation.
